tools.hypothesis: A 3-segment arm (0.18/0.12/0.10 m, low-stiffness circles r=0.0095, 6 external tendons in two polar spans: 0-2 at phases 0/120/240 deg and 1-2 at 60/180/300 deg, radius 0.018 m) provides enough total arc length (>0.40 m vs 0.348 m straight-line target distance) and enough independent 3D bending authority to reach (0.29,-0.035,0.19) and hold.

The previous invalidity was caused only by explicit per-segment `sections`/`cells` entries (EXACT_SECTION_STATIONS_REQUIRED), not by the chosen topology: a 3-segment chain of 0.18/0.12/0.10 m (total 0.40 m > 0.348 m straight-line target distance) with 6 tendons in two polar spans (0-2 at 0/120/240 deg, 1-2 at 60/180/300 deg, radius 0.018 m) generates a valid executable candidate when sections and cells are inherited from assembly prototypes.

Competing explanation to the previous design: the target is essentially the near-straight tip of the frozen baseline 2-segment chain (0.294 m straight vs 0.295 m required), so a 2-segment arm of lengths 0.16/0.11 m with 6 tendons in two polar spans needs only small curvature to hit the target, keeping gravity droop and required tension differentials moderate. The alternative (a 0.40 m 3-segment chain, straight tip 0.424 m) would require large curl and therefore better-conditioned, higher-authority control than the soft inherited sections are likely to deliver, so it should be the weaker design for a 1 cm hold.

The frozen local-affine task-capability witness for candidate 829a9acf (sampled-feasible on all 13 requested constraints, holding max error 0.008 m, min tension margin 2.478 N inside [0.2, 7.8] N) contains a complete full-horizon held-input control sequence that can be emitted as a legal 0.5 s / 50-step ZOH tension schedule for the six tendons in declared order, so that it can be evaluated by one independent physical replay on the real candidate.

The frozen constant-reference NMPC controller, started from the standardized zero initial condition at the named task initializer, drives the 2-segment / 6-tendon candidate 829a9acf tip from its straight configuration (achieved world point approximately [0.298, 0, 0.15] m) to the target [0.29,-0.035,0.19] m within the 0.01 m tolerance by t=0.5 s and settles inside the final 0.05 s window (max error <= 0.01 m, max tip speed <= 0.02 m/s), because re-planning on measured backend state every 0.1 s compensates the model-to-realization gap that the open-loop local-affine witness cannot address.

The stored full-horizon ZOH schedule d8eb5a3f (derived by the sampled affine conic minimax witness 29574ad1, which verified all 13 sampled constraints in the GVS local affine model with ~20% normalized margin on holding speed and holding position at the standardized zero initial condition) still satisfies the sealed physical task when replayed open loop on the true backend: terminal error <= 0.01 m, final-window max position error <= 0.01 m, and final-window max tip speed <= 0.02 m/s. Competing explanation: the 0.076 m/s final-window speed of the closed-loop NMPC run reflects a genuine dynamic (vertical oscillation) of this compliant 2-segment/6-tendon design that no 0.5 s tension plan can settle, in which case the open-loop schedule will also show residual z-velocity at t=0.49-0.5 s.

The measured applied tension sequence of the completed NMPC execution 8a5e746f (position error 0.0033 m, final-window speed 0.076 m/s) is a far better geometric starting schedule than the affine-witness schedule d8eb5a3f (open-loop replay error 0.136 m), and can be materialized as a current-candidate-bound explicit ZOH schedule that a native MuJoCo direct-control search can then correct inside the final 0.25 s.

The complete native-optimized schedule 0537e9c8 (mujoco_nonlinear_task_capability_v1 best of a672542a: predicted holding max speed 0.02115 m/s at t=0.49 s, holding position within 0.01 m, terminal position error ~0.003 m) transfers closely enough to the independent physical evaluation backend to satisfy the full task, because the native diagnostic uses the same compiled MuJoCo family model with ideal absolute tensions and the same 0.01 s ZOH control grid.

tools.hypothesis: Native re-optimization (mujoco_nonlinear_task_capability_v1 result 437cad5d, J reduced 0.046385 -> 0.042538, source 025047ed) produced a schedule whose predicted worst constraint is holding_max_error_m 0.010425 m at t=0.45 s with holding speed inside 0.02 m/s; if native->physical transfer remains at the previously observed ~1% level, the independent full replay will fail holding position marginally (about 0.0100-0.0110 m) while passing holding speed, making 025047ed an improved measured base point but not yet a task pass.

The remaining violation is a bounded late-window vertical settling/oscillation offset, not a saturation or structural limit: the measured best trajectory (668abfa3) misses by only +0.43 mm of position at t=0.45 s and +0.84 mm/s of speed at t=0.49 s, terminal error at 0.5 s already passes at ~9.85 mm, the two dominant tendons (indices 1 and 5) carry 5.4-5.5 N of an 8 N limit (so tension headroom exists), and the native predictor reproduced the measurement to ~0.1e-3 m. Competing explanations kept explicit: (a) a genuine static tip-height deficit that only a slightly higher late-window bend can fix; (b) a lightly damped tip oscillation whose sign flip between 0.45 s and 0.49 s needs amplitude reduction; (c) a structural/actuation limit already reached, in which case no small bounded tension offset will move the measured violation. A measured physical-response correction applied only on tendons 1 and 5 with two knots at 0.42 s and 0.50 s discriminates (a)/(b) from (c) directly on the frozen evaluator.

The residual 3.1% gap of the best valid execution is a timing/lag artifact, not a static reach limit: the equilibrium construction proves a bounded static input [0.5499,4.9780,0.0429,0.1896,0.0218,4.4785] N holds the target with 8.96e-10 m residual inside [0,8] N, while the incumbent schedule only approaches its final input at t=0.5 and is still closing at 15-20 mm/s there. A smoothstep ramp from the frozen 0.2 N pretension to a 5% over-driven copy of that static input by t=0.20 s, then a constant hold to 0.50 s, gives ~0.25 s of dwell inside the 10 mm ball, so the residual speed collapses instead of cruising.

The 3.1% residual is caused by the incumbent schedule never reaching a holding input: its measured tensions still ramp at the horizon end (tendon_1 5.408 to 5.525 N) while the tip closes the last 10 mm at 15-20 mm/s, so the final window samples a transient pass rather than a settling point, which forces position and speed to trade across the measured frontier. Rebinding the candidate-bound source onto a smoothstep ramp that reaches 1.05x the verified static target input by t=0.20 s and then holds it constant to 0.50 s makes the scored window a settling phase, where tip speed decays without sacrificing position.

The only violated component in every measured attempt is final-window tip speed, and the incumbent open-loop source fails it because its commanded tensions are still ramping at the horizon end (tendon_1 5.408 to 5.525 N), so the tip is crossing the target volume rather than settling. The equilibrium construction supplies a bounded input [0.5499,4.9780,0.0429,0.1896,0.0218,4.4785] N whose static equilibrium is the target itself (residual 8.96e-10 m inside [0,8] N); applying it by t=0.18 s and then holding it constant converts the 0.45-0.50 s window into a settling phase in which speed decays below 0.02 m/s while position stays inside the 10 mm ball. Undriven at 1.0x (not over-driven) so that the equilibrium is not placed beyond the target.

Rows 0-40 of the incumbent produce the measured approach and are kept bit-identical. The measured speed is 14.2 mm/s at t=0.45 but accelerates to 20.62 mm/s at t=0.47 while tender_1 falls 5.42 to 4.90 N, so the 0.62 mm/s violation is produced by unloading the bend under load (a release transient), and the t=0.50 sample additionally follows a +0.62 N tendon_1 step in the final 10 ms. Replacing that dip-and-step with a monotone blend toward the verified static hold, and buying 0.31 mm at t=0.45 with a 2 percent earlier drive increase, should clear both components without changing the approach that the plant has already been measured to follow.

The task is not satisfied by this candidate under any control mechanism the frozen grants and remaining budget permit. Measured evidence localizes the residual to the structure of the final-window approach rather than to command authority: position and speed trade strictly along a frontier traced by six schedules, the approach behaves radially with r/|v| about 0.48-0.50 s so that the 10 mm and 0.02 m/s limits are attained together only if that ratio is exceeded, and the acceptance boundary therefore coincides with the plant's own approach ratio. Feedback (NMPC) escapes the position side only by driving through the reference at 76 mm/s, and local knot or coefficient search cannot cross the frontier, as two independent native searches with exactly zero improvement and two failing authored schedules show.

Feedback escapes the position side only by driving through the reference (NMPC 0.004339 m position but 0.076149 m/s speed, in part because the frozen recipe sets holding_brake_lead_s to 0.0), and local search cannot cross the frontier, as two independent native 24-coefficient searches returned improvement exactly 0.0 and two authored schedules were 2.4x and 10.8x worse on speed.

original_plan.expected_observation: STOP is sealed with the original task acceptance unmeasured and unpassed. The documented outcome is that no complete fresh independent final-fidelity execution of any candidate-bound source satisfied both holding_position (0.01 m) and holding_max_speed_m_s (0.02 m/s); the best valid execution ecba8d8e stands 3.0957 percent over on position (0.010309570 m) and 3.1241 percent over on speed (0.020624822 m/s). Expected on any later re-read: 22 fresh results retained, nine independent physical evaluations retained, best valid unchanged, no selection made.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Original task conditions unaltered throughout: candidate 829a9acf, target (0.29,-0.035,0.19) m, zero initial condition with 0.2 N standardized pretension, 0.01 s control period, 0.0005 s timestep, 0.5 s horizon, 0.05 s holding window, limits 0.01 m and 0.02 m/s, input bounds [0,8] N, frozen protocol task-local-v2. No task, evaluator, reference, budget, study identity or historical result was modified; the recorded migration is an output-allowance addendum with material_behavior_change false.
original_plan.hypothesis: The task is not satisfied by this candidate under any control mechanism reachable within the frozen grants and remaining budget. Measured evidence localizes the residual to the geometry of the final-window approach rather than to command authority: six distinct schedules trace a strict position-speed frontier, the critical samples show an essentially radial approach with r/|v| about 0.48 to 0.50 s, and the acceptance boundary of 10 mm paired with 0.02 m/s coincides with that same ratio, so entering the admissible set requires exceeding the plant's own approach ratio. Feedback escapes the position side only by driving through the reference (NMPC 0.004339 m position but 0.076149 m/s speed, in part because the frozen recipe sets holding_brake_lead_s to 0.0), and local search cannot cross the frontier, as two independent native 24-coefficient searches returned improvement exactly 0.0 and two authored schedules were 2.4x and 10.8x worse on speed.
original_plan.interpretation: Outcome: no pass, no selection, study closed without claiming structural or global infeasibility. All 22 fresh results are cited in supporting_evidence and explained here. Physical final-fidelity evaluations: 668abfa3 (0.010425378 m, 0.020842103 m/s); 5130395b (position 0.009283115 m passes, speed 0.031142964 m/s fails); 9d622680 (0.011125787 m, 0.027283306 m/s, terminal 0.010907002 m fails); b2526dcb (0.010417454 m, 0.024756923 m/s); ecba8d8e (best valid: 0.010309570 m and 0.020624822 m/s, both violated; samples at 0.45 s give error 0.010309570 m with speed 0.014201694 m/s, at 0.47 s speed 0.020624822 m/s, at 0.50 s speed 0.020616766 m/s). Feedback execution: 8a5e746f (NMPC closed loop: holding position 0.004339182 m passes, terminal 0.003301097 m passes, speed 0.076149325 m/s fails, 5 deadline misses, real-time not demonstrated). Search receipts: d8aa43b3 (physical response search, predicted improvement 0.011657 against realized 0.011297). Mathematical results: 29574ad1 (sampled-affine-conic-minimax task capability), 437cad5d, c5dbcc8f, b8855273 (native sequence predictions), f199adb2 (native search from fff39986: initial_J equals J equals 0.0312410769054432, improvement 0.0, 101 callbacks, 101000 physics steps, worst holding_max_speed 0.020624821538108865 at 0.47 s), 82b8a363 (bounded static target input [0.5499,4.9780,0.0429,0.1896,0.0218,4.4785] N with residual 8.96e-10 m), 210d92ae (authored smoothstep hold: native window speed 0.222192789 m/s at 0.5 s, 11x limit, improvement 0.062457 from initial_J 10.172096606), 0b34f8b7 (anchored monotone-unload variant: native window speed 0.047081736 m/s, initial_J 1.441805167 to J 1.354086807). Supporting bookkeeping artifacts ab17dcd6, efe12762, 67c00865, a672542a, f1f237dd, 29e48919, e4ea0c5c are also cited. No training was run, so no RL summary exists; the RL routes were judged unusable at 32768 total actions for a task whose best hand-engineered schedule misses by 3 percent. Remaining scientific uncertainty, stated rather than resolved: a different structure, the controller-only weights holding_tip_speed_weight and terminal_tip_speed_weight that would require a new candidate identity, the exhausted offline NLP allowance, and any parameterization or solver outside the frozen grants remain untested; finite search failure is not structural infeasibility, fixed-control sensitivity is not reoptimized capability, and no hardware, robustness, repeatability, optimality or cross-task claim follows from this study.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Study closed. Exploration terminated without a passing execution because no complete fresh independent final-fidelity evaluation of any candidate-bound source satisfied both original holding limits, and no remaining authorized mechanism offered a materially different route to the boundary within the frozen grants and remaining budget. The original task acceptance remains unmeasured and unpassed; no further confirmations, retries, transfers, resets or extensions are requested.
original_plan.weakening_observation: This closure would be weakened, not confirmed, if a later re-read revealed a fresh complete physical evaluation with holding_position at or below 0.01 m and holding_max_speed_m_s at or below 0.02 m/s that was never publicly read, or if a granted method were shown admissible that can cross a measured Pareto frontier of this schedule family; either would mean the stop was declared too early. Neither appears in the 22-entry fresh-result index, and the two candidate control sources created during this session (64150841, 74cd11a4) are unmeasured plans or predictions, not passes.
